comments.author: TheReaper
comments.body_html: The mod works fine, but i wanted to change the background colours of my ammo to be based on penetration. For some reason when i change the configuration to colour the background based on penetration, it still colours the background based on rating. I am still very new to modding games, so i probably am struggling to find the issue, but i just wanted to point this out incase this problem isnt usual or i just have no idea how to fix it.

comments.author: Szonszczyk
comments.body_html: In config file you should have only one mode (rating/penetration) enabled (changed to true), if multiple are enabled, the last one is processed - in this case rating. Please make sure you have only one mode enabled
